description: Retrieves a specific access control rule for a calendar. Use when you need to check permissions for a specific user, group, or domain.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

rule_id.description: ACL rule identifier. Format: 'scope_type:scope_value' or 'default'. Valid scope types: 'user' (email), 'group' (group email), 'domain' (domain name), 'default' (public access). Examples: 'user:john@example.com', 'group:team@example.com', 'domain:example.com', 'default'. Note: 'me' is NOT valid; use actual email/domain. The rule must exist - use GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_ACL_RULES to find valid IDs.
rule_id.title: Rule Id

name: acl_get

display_url.description: Direct link to the calendar settings page where this ACL rule can be managed.
display_url.title: Display Url

role.description: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values: 'none', 'freeBusyReader', 'reader', 'writer', 'owner'.
role.title: Role

scope.description: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this ACL rule.
scope.title: Scope

type.description: The type of the scope. Possible values: 'default', 'user', 'group', 'domain'.
type.title: Type

value.description: The email address of a user or group, or the name of a domain, depending on the scope type. Omitted for type 'default'.
value.title: Value
